subject: Sunfield Solutions — banking info for vendor onboarding and PO label guidance
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lara Kim <lara.kim@sunfieldsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Sunfield onboarding — banking details & invoice labeling (action required)

Hi Lara,

Thanks for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. To complete vendor activation for ACH/wires and ensure timely remittance we need a couple of items from your side: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached).
- Bank proof (bank letter or voided check) showing account holder name.
- Signed W-9 (US vendors).

A few operational notes for our payments team so your invoices route cleanly: 
- Please put the Redwood PO number and invoice number in the invoice filename and in the remittance string (example remittance string we prefer: \"PO: 78934 | INV: SF-2025-088\").
- Preferred payment method: ACH (ACH routing/account preferred). Wires accepted for first remittance if timing requires.
- Micro-deposit verification: our finance team will run micro-deposits to confirm the account if you provide ACH. Expected timeline: 48–72 hours after we submit the test.

I've attached the vendor onboarding form for you to fill and return, plus a sample remittance-labeling template. Once we have the bank proof and W-9, Jordan will kick off the payment channel activation.

Next steps: can you return the filled form and bank proof by Wednesday 11/5? If you prefer, you can also upload directly to the Drive link below.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_template.pdf, remit_label_sample.txt
Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_vendor_docs

Hi Soojin — thanks, sending the first wave of documents. See attached: signed W-9 and bank letter. We filled the onboarding form and included our preferred remittance string.

Bank details (masked here; full details attached in bank letter PDF):
- Bank: First Harbor Bank
- Account name: Sunfield Solutions LLC
- Account ending: 4321
- Routing: 122000038
- Preferred method: ACH (USD)

We can accept micro-deposit verification. Please confirm the amounts before you post the test so our finance team can verify on receipt. Also, our AP team prefers weekly remittances on Fridays; initial payment can be done via wire if that moves the first invoice sooner.

Attachments included: sunfield_w9_signed.pdf, sunfield_bank_letter.pdf, vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf

Thanks Lara — received everything, uploading to the vendor record now. Quick confirmation items from finance before we activate the ACH channel:

1) Micro-deposit amounts we will send: $0.11 and $0.22 (two deposits). Expect these in the account within 24–48 hours after we initiate. Please confirm you can monitor for those and reply with the exact amounts when they appear.

2) Remittance string we will include on payment records: \"PO: [PO_NUMBER] | INV: [INVOICE_NUMBER] | REMIT: Sunfield Solutions\" — please confirm that format works.

3) For the first remittance: we can schedule a wire to expedite the initial payment if you send a priority confirmation. If you prefer ACH, earliest settlement will be Friday 11/07 as a standard batch. Let us know which you want.

Action items for Sunfield: confirm micro-deposit monitoring (yes/no) and whether you want the first payment as wire or ACH.

—
Jordan Blake
